description: This file contains utility functions for generating random numbers and related operations, likely used within a graphics or compute shader context, including a hash function, uniform random number generators, and a Gaussian random number generator implemented via the Box-Muller transform.

methods.name: uint pcg_hash(uint v)
methods.description: Hash function used to generate pseudo-random values from an integer input, based on a GPU-friendly hashing scheme.

methods.name: float rand2(ivec4 pos)
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random float in [0,1) based on a 4D integer position vector.

methods.name: float rand2_nonzero(ivec4 pos)
methods.description: Generates a non-zero pseudo-random float in [0,1), retrying if zero.

methods.name: float get_uniform(ivec4 pos,float from,float to)
methods.description: Linearly interpolates a uniform random number to a specified range [from, to].

methods.name: float get_gaussrand(ivec4 pos,float mean,float std)
methods.description: Generates a Gaussian-distributed random number using the Box-Muller transform, based on a 4D position vector and specified mean and standard deviation.

ctags.pattern: /^float get_gaussrand(ivec4 pos, float mean, float std) {$/
